why: Same conclusion: nested open neighbourhoods O(i) of x0 with cl_X{x in O(i) | f(x)=0} a compact subset of X_i for the level topology; A phrases it as levelVal '' K = closure with K compact in PX.Level i (= levelSet i with levelTopology i), B as closure inside levelSet i plus compactness of its preimage, equivalent by injectivity of levelVal. At HEAD both sides use the germ reading of Definition 3.11 (theorem_3_12's hypothesis IsScFredholmGerm and B's IsScFredholmGermTame both have the filling and the sc+-section as germs, IsFillingGerm/IsScPlusGerm), so the hypotheses match in kind; A => B discards B's extra hypotheses: tameness of the bundle (IsTameStrongBundle), tame germ data (IsScFredholmGermTame.isScFredholmGerm: a tame chart is a chart) and sc-smoothness of f (A needs only IsSection). B => A fails genuinely: theorem_3_1_13_preprint has no tameness of the bundle or of the chart and no sc-smoothness of f, and A's other conjuncts (the local theorem for basic germs, snd_eq_zero_iff, continuity of levelChartSymm, a closure lemma) are auxiliary statements B does not speak about.
